structure.note: One class of registered shares (3,341,581,714 issued at end-2025, including 249,882,523 treasury shares; nominal USD 0.10), listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange and, as global registered shares, on the NYSE. The only holders above 3% of the voting rights under FMIA notifications at year end were BlackRock (5.01%, 30 November 2023) and Norges Bank (4.90%, 22 January 2025); on 17 February 2026 Norges Bank disclosed a holding below 3%. Registration is optional and a 5% voting limit applies to registered shareholders other than securities clearing organizations.

notes: Fiscal year ended 31 December 2025. Source is the UBS Group AG Annual Report 2025 as filed on Form 20-F (accession 0001610520-26-000023, filed March 9, 2026), read on www.sec.gov. Dividends are cross-checked against SEC XBRL companyfacts (CIK 0001610520). UBS reports in USD; values in USD bn (geography is reported only to one decimal in USD bn). GEOGRAPHY: the four regions are recorded; the 'Global' line (revenues not attributed to a region) was negative in 2025 (USD -0.4bn) and is left out of segments because a negative share cannot be shown, so the regions add to USD 49.9bn against the reported total of USD 49.6bn. LEADER: Sergio Ermotti (Group CEO since 2023, also 2011-2020) held 2,255,862 vested shares plus 675,066 unvested/at-risk shares (2,930,928 in total, including related parties) at 31 December 2025; shares records the vested figure. The table's 'potentially conferred voting rights' column shows 0.222%, which counts unvested shares and is a voting-rights measure, so it is not used as pctEconomic. No economic percentage is disclosed, so pctEconomic is null. HOLDERS: FMIA notifications measure % of 'the voting rights associated with the total share capital ... at the time of the respective disclosure notification'; with one share class this is equivalent to share of capital. Dates are the notification dates (BlackRock's is from 30 November 2023). Norges Bank (4.90% at year end) is left out because it disclosed a holding below 3% on 17 February 2026; NBIM's own file shows 2.9% at June 30, 2026 (owners lens). DTC (Cede & Co.) is registered with 7.69% but is a clearing nominee, not a beneficial owner. BUYBACKS: 3.00 = shares bought under the 2024 and 2025 share repurchase programs (acquisition cost USD 3,000m; the 2024 program concluded May 23, 2025 and the 2025 program November 20, 2025, with the shares intended for cancellation). Excluded: USD 2,365m of shares bought to hedge employee share-based compensation, and Investment Bank market-making. The cash-flow line 'Net movements in treasury shares and own equity derivative activity' (USD 5,178m outflow) is net and mixes these with market-making and derivatives, so it is not used. DIVIDENDS: USD 2,866m distributions paid on UBS Group AG shares. STOCK COMP: USD 1,095m total personnel expense for share-based equity-settled compensation excluding social security (Note 26 footnote 4); the statement of changes in equity credits USD 1,107m of share-based compensation expensed in the income statement.

taxes.notes: Fiscal year ended 31 December 2025. Taxes: ifrs-full:IncomeTaxesPaidRefund, net of refunds as presented. R&D not reported as a separate line (bank).

paidout.notes: Fiscal year ended 31 December 2025 (FY2025 Form 20-F, accession 0001610520-26-000023). Bank: paidOut is null and not comparable (operating cash flow is dominated by balance-sheet funding flows). altPaidOut per PAIDOUT.md = noninterest (operating) expenses − D&A − stock comp + income taxes paid. Interest paid in cash (37,749), mostly to depositors and funding counterparties, is recorded separately and not added. Capex (2,362 property, equipment and software) is recorded for context but not added, per the PAIDOUT.md bank formula. FY2025 still includes Credit Suisse integration costs inside operating expenses.

owners.notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); NBIM also holds UBS Group AG and subsidiary bonds in separate rows, not counted. NBIM's 2.9% matches the February 17, 2026 FMIA notification of a holding below 3%. CalPERS: the information table of its Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 lists no UBS shares (searched by issuer name). Holders of record: registered shareholders in the UBS share register only (229,388 holding 1,415,015,852 shares, 42.3% of shares issued); 57.7% of shares issued were not registered, so the true number of holders is larger.

marketcap.notes: One class of registered shares, listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (UBSG.SW, CHF) and on the NYSE as global registered shares (UBS, USD); the 3Q26 report says the shares are listed on the NYSE 'as global registered shares', so the NYSE line is the same shares, not an ADR. The NYSE line, in US dollars (the reporting currency), is used. The count is shares issued minus treasury shares at September 30, 2026, from the 3Q26 report, because no document states shares outstanding excluding treasury shares directly; 149 million of the treasury shares were bought under repurchase programs for cancellation. The FY2025 20-F cover (3,341,581,714 issued including 249,882,523 treasury shares at December 31, 2025) is older.
